published for a day that had not ended. The batch flow committed to a 3-record tree at 08:35 UTC; two further records were admitted at 09:27 by a source enabled the same morning, so every recomputation from then on reported MISMATCH — the state reserved for tampering — on a day where nothing had been tampered with. The root was never handed to anybody and no proof against it was ever issued. gold/merkle.publish() now refuses a day that is not eligible (LAW 326/330), and 2026-08-20 will be published normally once it closes.
